# Hassan Nasiri Khonsari (حسن نصیری خونساری)

> Iranian mechanical and mechatronics design engineer (Sharif University of Technology alumnus, Alborz Prize laureate); not to be confused with the singer Hassan Nasiri. He designs custom machinery and industrial robots and follows them through fabrication, assembly and commissioning; he also offers quality-controlled batch production of industrial parts and consulting. Based in Tehran, Iran.

> مهندس طراحی مکانیک و مکاترونیک، دانش‌آموخته‌ی دانشگاه صنعتی شریف و برگزیده‌ی جایزه‌ی البرز؛ این شخص با حسن نصیری، خواننده، متفاوت است.

## Key facts

- MSc in Mechanical Engineering (Applied Design), Sharif University of Technology (supervisor: Prof. Mohammad Durali); BSc, Iran University of Science and Technology.
- Led the mechanical design of Iran National Post's postal sorting robots (Tensor Intelligent Machines) across three generations: 80 robots in Tehran and Kermanshah; third generation produced as a 200-unit series (1.8 m/s, ~10 kg, 55×55 cm).
- Built a 6-DOF knee prosthesis constraint and stability test apparatus per ASTM F1223 — the first of its kind in Iran.
- Awards: Laureate, 64th Alborz Prize (2026); 2nd Place, 26th Khwarizmi Youth Award (2025); 2nd Place, 24th Khwarizmi Youth Award (2023).
- Publication: “Frictional behavior between bone and additively manufactured Ti6Al4V implants is affected by bone density and surface texture under varying loads”, Scientific Reports, 2025 (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-25586-0).
- Current role: Senior Mechanical Engineer at Karun HiTech Solutions (8,000+ industrial parts delivered).
- Open to: design-and-build projects, multi-robot mobile fleets, batch production of parts with QC, automation/PLC, test rigs, career and award-application consulting. Not seeking employment.

## Projects

- [Postal Sorting Robots](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/postal-sorting-robots.html): Iran's first postal sorting robot of its type: 80 robots in Tehran and Kermanshah, and a 200-unit third generation.
- [Knee Prosthesis Constraint and Stability Test Apparatus](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/knee-prosthesis-test-rig.html): Six-DOF testing of total knee replacements per ASTM F1223 — the first apparatus of its kind in Iran.
- [Industrial FDM 3D Printers](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/industrial-3d-printers.html): Five machines, from 200×200×150 mm up to 500×500×400 mm with ball screws and industrial linear rails.
- [Dual-Purpose Industrial CNC](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/dual-purpose-cnc.html): A CNC for wood and light metals that becomes a large 3D printer with a head change.
- [Waiter Robots](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/waiter-robots.html): A fleet of seven waiter robots — Iran's first waiter robot of its type.
- [Kach and Karnak Mobile Robots (LeaMech)](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/leamech-mobile-robots.html): A platform for mobile service robots: the ROS-based Kach and the omnidirectional, mecanum-wheeled Karnak.
- [DMD Powder Feeder](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/dmd-powder-feeder.html): A powder feeder for laser direct metal deposition, controlled from 1 to 100 g/min.
- [Cable-Driven Drawing Robot](https://hassannasiri.ir/en/projects/cable-drawing-robot.html): A cable robot that turns any photo into a line drawing and draws it on canvas.
